actual_numeric_qa.scope: Aggregate arithmetic, output hashes and accounting; not semantic accuracy and not an independent variance recomputation.

input_scope.parent_frame: 69-cell technology-screened candidate frame, not all US vacancies
input_scope.reference: Unchanged Batch069 Pro operational reference, not independent human truth

q1_equal_major_decisions.use: Report no clear difference within known-reference domain; old positive proxy difference is not robust.
Descriptive known-domain estimate; no clear directional difference.
Positive difference conditional on known Pro-reference domain; full-frame sign remains unidentified once unresolved membership/outcomes are allowed.
Reference-weighted conditional comparison only; selected old narrow source has no compatible outcome comparator. No before-after correction claim.

q2_decisions.main_eligibility: Explicit new-graduate OR no-experience wording, retaining original conditional/unconditional distinctions.
q2_decisions.old_comparator: Not available in selected frozen parent narrow source. Q2 uses explicitly named reference-only HT estimation, not an old-rule error-correction success. This does not assert that no richer historical artifact ever contained entry/duty evidence.
q2_decisions.GenAI_vs_software: Not adopted for a directional conclusion: only14known GenAI eligible-duty ads pooled, and zero in one required major; equal-major point unavailable without renormalization.
q2_decisions.use: Report coexistence of explicit entry eligibility and current responsibilities in this restricted target. Do not infer seniorization over time, required-versus-preferred duty strength, or an AI causal effect.

inference_limitations: All main points are reference-known-domain ratios; full-target unknown envelopes are separate conservative HT sensitivity summaries, not CIs or sharp joint bounds.
Approximate normal design intervals condition on independently salted MD5 ordering being exchangeable SRS; they do not account for common Pro reference error.

Sparse or boundary Q2 domains, including a single supporting advertisement with observed SE0, are descriptive only. A zero plug-in delta SE is not certainty; do not use its zero-width interval as inferential evidence.
For Q1 unavailable OLD outcomes, only numerator auxiliary is zero; a valid old A/B denominator remains. It is constant within arm-cell and census-minus-HT calibrated; Q2 both auxiliaries are zero.
Old proxy versus Pro reference differences can include measurement-definition differences, not solely extraction mistakes.
No old table, labels, weights or relation-model stop decision changed.

execution_failures_preserved.reason: Existing Wuzhen Anaconda lacked duckdb before research calculation; five synthetic method checks passed. Used already installed Kunshan runtime, no installation.
Independent verifier incorrectly required zero denominator auxiliary for Q1 zero-outcome auxiliary. Fixed component-specific assertion only; original estimates unchanged.
Verifier str.removeprefix unavailable on existing Python3.8; string-slicing compatibility fix only.

formal_corpus_semantic_production: Still unfinished. This wave estimates statistics; it does not repair individual corpus labels.
automatic_next_action: None. Authorized bounded statistical delivery stops after publication; no annotation, parser, model or corpus rerun.
